model_assumptions.approval_scope: Individual geometry/direction/storage and explicit synthetic eligibility; not whole-network OSM or 180K acceptance
model_assumptions.boundary: Incoming/outgoing modeled traffic conditions, not parking generation
model_assumptions.exits: Budget applies to departure cohort hour; actual exit hour cannot be inferred before QSim
model_assumptions.internal: Synthetic available vehicles; public/property authorization is not asserted
model_assumptions.capacity: Existing modeled bottlenecks, never observed counts; no physical QSim capacity modified
